records.title: Classical Ethiopic
records.text: GEEZ 101 Classical Ethiopic (5) One of the most important Semitic languages of the Near East and East Africa, and the classical language of modern day Ethiopia and Eritrea, a region known as the "Horn of Africa". Introduces the basic alphabet and fundamental grammar of classical Ethiopic, or Ge'ez.
